thread:
samir: FYI — onboarding samplekit crashes when using JSON mode + function calling. Repro attached.
aj: ugh, details?
samir: Steps: 1) use sdk-js samplekit 2) enable jsonMode && fnCall helper 3) hit flaky auth retry; response becomes unparsable
samir: Example of returned text (from logs):
```
{"type":"function_call","name":"create_order","arguments":"{\"items\":[{\"id\":\"sku_123\",\"qty\":1}],\"meta\":{\"user\":\"u1\"}}"}
```
samir: note: arguments is a string containing a serialized JSON instead of an object — seems double-encoded only after an auth retry.
maria: Is this happening on both JS and Python SDKs or just JS?
aj: i reproduced on js, but tests on py show correct object shape normally. suspect retry wrapper serializes payload again when re-sending.
jen: which retry/transport are you using? fetch-retry or our internal http client?
samir: internal http client with exponential backoff (default). i can repro by forcing a 401 then auto-refresh token.
kevin: can we add a quick unit that simulates token-refresh path and asserts the outgoing request body remains unchanged? Seems like a serializer is run twice.
aj: minimal repro (js):
```
// pseudo
const resp = await RedwoodSDK.create({
  model: 'gpt-xyz',
  functions: myFns,
  jsonMode: true,
  input: {items:[{id:'sku_123', qty:1}]}
})
// after auth refresh the outgoing body captured -> arguments is a string
```
aj: hypothesis: retry code calls JSON.stringify on request body for logging or headers, then passes the string into the transport which stringifies again.
maria: we also saw similar parity issues with schema helpers earlier in a different sample app — not identical but related to how helpers coerce types.
jen: quick hotfix idea: make retry middleware operate on a cloned, already-serialized buffer rather than re-running serialize. OR mark request as alreadySerialized.
samir: i hacked an overlay in samplekit that sets request._serialized = true and it fixed the double-escape locally (dirty but proves root cause).
kevin: action: add an integration test in samplekit that forces auth refresh and inspects wire payload. assign to aj?
aj: i'll take it. I'll also audit transport layer to ensure idempotent serialization.
maria: note for SDK parity: please check python sdk's retry does not re-serialize when body is bytes. py likely sends bytes and js sends object -> different behavior. we need explicit contract (body must be string/bytes by transport).
samir: small UX note: when jsonMode + fncall detect malformed JSON we should include a helpful error with example of expected shape, not just 500.
kevin: agree — add an eval/human-friendly message for onboarding. low effort, high ROI.
dev-bot: automated test run for pr #4218: auth-retry-serialization-check — 1 failed, replicates double-encode on js-samplekit
jen: thanks for running that. aj, can you post a short diff suggestion or a link to a small PR that we can ship as a patch for the sample app today?
aj: will open a tiny PR to guard the serializer and add the integration test. linking soon.
samir: thanks. leaving notes in samplekit README about jsonMode caveats and a troubleshooting snippet:
```
// if arguments appears as a JSON string in logs, you probably hit double-serialize during retry.
// workarounds:
// 1) pin auth token refresh to synchronous path in samplekit
// 2) upgrade to SDK patch X.Y
```
maria: :thumbsup: nice. tagging product to consider a small docs blurb about this for onboarding.
kevin: marking this resolved for now, moving action items to aj and test infra. re-open if it hits dedicated customers.
samir: noted, thanks all."
